profile.title: The Evolution of the
profile.desc: Emerging from the most physical and highly contested pitches, Bertoni consolidated his reputation through an implacable mindset of impact and resilience. Operating in the back row, he combines a back's speed with the brute force required to dictate the scrum's tempo.
profile.card_1_desc: Superior reaction speed to secure turnovers and stabilize possession under extreme physical pressure.
profile.card_2_desc: Explosive capacity to break the first tackle line and maintain positive momentum on the field.
profile.card_3_desc: Active voice in defensive coordination and forward mechanics, dictating aggressiveness with tactical intelligence.
profile.card_4_desc: Sharp game reading to cover deep ground and neutralize opposition tactical kicks.

timeline.title: Strategic Planning 2026
timeline.q1_desc: Integration into high-performance training centers in Ireland. Focus on metabolic optimization and reactive strength to endure the European climate.
timeline.q2_desc: Insertion into top regional tournaments and high-level exhibition matches. Workload testing and tactical cohesion in the Dublin circuit.
